tools.name: bmi_calculator
tools.description: Body mass index from height and weight, its WHO adult category, and the weight range WHO calls normal for that height. Height (height_cm, or height_ft with height_in) and weight (weight_kg or weight_lb) are both required.

tools.name: calorie_calculator
tools.description: Daily calories for an adult to maintain weight, lose body fat or build muscle. Works out maintenance from age, sex, height, weight and how active a normal day is, not counting exercise, then the daily target and its range for the goal. tools.name: protein_calculator
tools.description: Daily protein range in grams from body weight and whether the person exercises most weeks, and the amount at each eating time when the number of eating times a day is given. Weight (weight_kg or weight_lb) is also required.

tools.name: water_intake_calculator
tools.description: Daily water intake for an adult woman or man from the European and US reference values, including pregnancy and breastfeeding, and how much of it usually comes from drinks. With weights before and after an exercise session, also how much to drink after it.
